# satgate

> satgate is a pay-per-token (or pay-per-request) inference proxy for OpenAI-compatible endpoints: Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, or a hosted API (set UPSTREAM_API_KEY for one that needs a key). Clients pay over Lightning, Cashu ecash, LNURLcash (LUD-25) bearer notes or x402 stablecoins; no accounts, no API keys. Payment handling comes from toll-booth.

One command turns a local inference server into a billable API endpoint. satgate auto-detects your models, issues HTTP 402 payment challenges, proxies requests once paid, and bills from the token counts the upstream reports, returning any unused hold to the client's credit balance.

## Live Demo

A public instance is running at https://satgate.trotters.dev — open it in a browser for the chat playground, or point any OpenAI-compatible client at it. Discovery endpoints:

- https://satgate.trotters.dev/.well-known/l402
- https://satgate.trotters.dev/llms.txt
- https://satgate.trotters.dev/openapi.json

## Getting Started

```bash
LIGHTNING_KEY=<phoenixd password> npx satgate --upstream http://localhost:11434 --lightning phoenixd
```

satgate queries `/v1/models` on startup, charges over Lightning, and proxies paid inference traffic to your backend. Without `--lightning` (or Cashu mints, or an allowlist) it runs in open mode, with no payment or authentication, and stays local unless `--tunnel` is passed.

With no pricing configured, each request costs a flat 1 sat. Set `--token-price`, `--model-price` or a `pricing:` block for per-token billing, or `--price` for a different flat price. For production, create `satgate.yaml`:

```yaml
upstream: http://localhost:11434
port: 3000
lightning: phoenixd          # or lnbits, lnd, cln, nwc; key in LIGHTNING_KEY
storage: sqlite              # the default when a payment rail is configured
dbPath: ./satgate.db

pricing:
  default: 1                 # sats per 1k tokens for unlisted models
  models:
    llama3: 1
    deepseek-r1: 5
    mixtral-8x22b: 3

maxTokens: 2048              # cap on completion tokens per request

freeTier:
  creditsPerDay: 250         # free sats of credit per client IP per day

capacity:
  maxConcurrent: 4           # default 8; 0 = unlimited

trustProxy: true             # only behind a reverse proxy
trustedProxies:
  - 127.0.0.1

tiers:
  - amountSats: 1000
    creditSats: 1000
    label: "1,000 sats"
  - amountSats: 5000
    creditSats: 5500
    label: "5,000 sats (10% bonus)"
```

## Key Concepts

- **Model pricing**: per-model rates in sats per 1,000 tokens. Unlisted models fall back to the `default` rate. Resolution order: exact match, case-insensitive match (a missing tag counts as `:latest`), Ollama tag stripping (`llama3:8b` to `llama3`), then default. Requests naming a model that is neither auto-detected nor priced are refused with a 400, so an alias cannot fall through to the default price.
- **Flat pricing**: `--price <sats>` (or `price:` in the config file) charges a fixed amount per request instead. A price of 0 serves inference free.
- **Token counting**: billing uses the prompt and completion token counts the upstream reports, from the JSON body or, for streams, the final usage event (satgate always sets `stream_options.include_usage`). Completion tokens include any reasoning tokens. Only if the upstream reports no usage does satgate estimate from generated chunks, with a floor of one token per four bytes.
- **Holds and reconciliation**: before calling the upstream, satgate holds the most the request could cost: every byte of the body as a prompt token plus `max_tokens` for each choice (`n`/`best_of`, at most 8). `max_tokens` is clamped to `maxTokens` (default 2048) and set when absent. A credit balance that cannot cover the hold gets a 402. Afterwards the charge is settled to the reported usage, rounded up to the next sat, and the rest returns to the balance. Each request settles its own hold, so concurrent requests on one credential are billed correctly.
- **Per-request payments**: an IETF Payment charge pays exactly `estimatedCostSats` for one request and cannot be topped up or refunded, so `max_tokens` is shrunk to fit it and a larger prompt is refused. The same applies to the free tier and IETF Payment sessions.
- **Capacity management**: `maxConcurrent` limits simultaneous inference requests (default 8). Requests beyond it get a 503. Set to `0` to disable the limit.
- **Free tier**: an optional daily allowance of credit, in sats, per client IP. Each free request uses `estimatedCostSats` of it (or the flat price). Resets at midnight UTC.
- **Client IPs**: without `trustProxy`, the TCP peer address identifies a client. Behind a reverse proxy set `trustProxy` (and `trustedProxies`) so `X-Forwarded-For` is read instead; otherwise every client looks like the proxy.
- **Invoice limits**: each client IP may hold 20 unpaid invoices (`maxPendingInvoicesPerIp`) before further challenges get a 429.
- **Payment tiers with volume discounts**: clients choose a tier amount when buying credit. Each tier can grant bonus credit (e.g. pay 5,000 sats, receive 5,500 in credit).

## Payment Rails

- **Lightning**: `--lightning phoenixd | lnbits | lnd | cln | nwc`. For nwc, `LIGHTNING_KEY` names a file holding the `nostr+walletconnect://` URI. Lightning enables L402 (credit: pay once, spend the balance over many requests) and IETF Payment (per-request charge, draft-ryan-httpauth-payment-01) credentials.
- **Cashu ecash**: `--cashu-mints <urls>`; clients send an `X-Cashu` token. With Lightning configured, received ecash is melted to your node.
- **LNURLcash (LUD-25) bearer notes**: `--lnurlcash-mints <hosts>`; clients send the note URL in `X-LNURLcash`. With Lightning configured, notes are melted to your node.
- **x402 stablecoins**: set `X402_RECEIVER`, `X402_NETWORK` and `X402_FACILITATOR_URL` (and `DEFAULT_PRICE_USD`); clients send a `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header.

## Supported Inference Endpoints

These endpoints require payment (or an allowlisted identity in allowlist mode):

- `POST /v1/chat/completions`: chat completions, streaming and buffered
- `POST /v1/completions`: legacy text completions
- `POST /v1/embeddings`: embedding generation

`HEAD` on any of them is a free price probe (`X-L402-Price-Sats`).

## Discovery Endpoints

These endpoints require no authentication and are designed for machine consumption:

- `GET /.well-known/l402`: pricing per model, tiers, payment methods and model list
- `GET /llms.txt`: a description of this instance, generated from its live configuration
- `GET /openapi.json`: OpenAPI 3.1 specification for client code generation
- `GET /v1/models`: standard OpenAI model listing, proxied from upstream

## Configuration

Configuration precedence: **CLI flags > environment variables > config file > defaults**.

### CLI flags

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--upstream <url>` | Upstream inference URL (default: auto-detect Ollama on :11434) |
| `--upstream-key-file <path>` | File holding a bearer key for the upstream |
| `--lightning <backend>` | `phoenixd`, `lnbits`, `lnd`, `cln` or `nwc` |
| `--cashu-mints <urls>` | Accepted Cashu mints |
| `--lnurlcash-mints <hosts>` | Accepted LNURLcash mint hosts |
| `--auth <mode>` | `open`, `lightning`, `cashu` or `allowlist` (inferred when omitted) |
| `--port <n>` | Port to listen on (default: 3000) |
| `--config <path>` | Path to a JSON or YAML config file |
| `--price <sats>` | Flat sats per request (flat pricing) |
| `--token-price <sats>` | Sats per 1k tokens (per-token pricing) |
| `--model-price <model:sats>` | Per-model token price (repeatable) |
| `--max-tokens <n>` | Cap on completion tokens per request (default: 2048) |
| `--max-concurrent <n>` | Max concurrent requests (default: 8; 0 = unlimited) |
| `--max-pending-invoices <n>` | Unpaid invoices per client IP (default: 20; 0 = unlimited) |
| `--storage <type>` | `memory` or `sqlite` (default: sqlite with a payment rail, else memory) |
| `--free-tier <n>` | Free credit, in sats, per client IP per day (default: 0) |
| `--trust-proxy` | Read client IPs from `X-Forwarded-For` / `X-Real-IP` |
| `--trusted-proxies <ips>` | Proxy IPs/IPv4 CIDRs to skip in `X-Forwarded-For` |
| `--tunnel` / `--no-tunnel` | Force the Cloudflare quick tunnel on or off |
| `--root-key <hex>` | Root key for macaroon signing (prefer `ROOT_KEY`) |

### Environment variables

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `UPSTREAM_URL` | Upstream inference URL |
| `UPSTREAM_API_KEY` | Bearer key for the upstream |
| `LIGHTNING_BACKEND`, `LIGHTNING_URL`, `LIGHTNING_KEY` | Lightning backend settings |
| `ROOT_KEY` | Root key for macaroon signing; otherwise generated and kept in `satgate.root-key` beside the database |
| `PORT` | Port to listen on |
| `STORAGE` | `memory` or `sqlite` |
| `DEFAULT_PRICE` | Default sats per 1k tokens |
| `SATGATE_TOKEN_PRICE` | Sats per 1k tokens (per-token pricing) |
| `SATGATE_MAX_TOKENS` | Cap on completion tokens per request |
| `SATGATE_ESTIMATED_COST` | Per-request hold, in sats |
| `FREE_TIER_CREDITS` | Free credit, in sats, per client IP per day |
| `MAX_CONCURRENT` | Max concurrent inference requests |
| `TRUST_PROXY`, `TRUSTED_PROXIES` | Reverse proxy settings |
| `SATGATE_MAX_PENDING_INVOICES` | Unpaid invoices per client IP |
| `CASHU_MINTS`, `LNURLCASH_MINTS` | Accepted mints |

### Config file

The config file (default: `satgate.yaml` or `satgate.json` in the working directory) accepts the settings above plus:

- `dbPath`: path to the SQLite database file (default: `./satgate.db`)
- `tiers`: array of `{ amountSats, creditSats, label }` objects for volume discount tiers
- `estimatedCostSats`: sats held per request before the token count is known. Default: `ceil((4096 + maxTokens) * dearestPrice / 1000)`, enough for a 4 KiB request plus a full `max_tokens` completion at the dearest configured per-1k price
- `maxBodySize`: maximum request body size in bytes (default: 10 MiB)
- `upstreamKeyFile`: file holding a bearer key for the upstream

## Ecosystem

satgate is built on **toll-booth**, HTTP 402 payment middleware that handles the invoice, credential and credit flow. It supports Lightning (phoenixd, LND, Core Lightning, LNbits and NWC wallets), Cashu ecash, LNURLcash notes and x402. satgate adds the inference-specific layer: model detection, token counting, holds and reconciliation, and capacity management.

The natural client counterpart is **402-mcp**, an MCP server that lets AI agents discover 402 APIs (via `/.well-known/l402`), pay from a connected wallet and consume the API with no human in the loop.

```
AI Agent -> 402-mcp -> satgate -> Your inference backend
```

- toll-booth: https://github.com/forgesworn/toll-booth
- 402-mcp: https://github.com/forgesworn/402-mcp
